latestPosts.caption:
I’m just a girl who learned how to clean from the internet! Name a cleaning hack and I’ve probably tried it 😂 I would’ve tried anything to make life more simple! I went from overwhelm to building habits and routines that actually worked. Is it always spotless? Absolutely not and I wouldn’t want it to be. I want my home to be lived in but I now know that little and often is far more achievable than a 2 hour cleaning marathon! Because what parent has time for that? I have learned how to prioritise better, I have a better mindset and I use those shortcuts that work because as mums, we need them! 😅 so if this is something you’d like to work on this year then follow along because I’d love to have you here! 
.
#cleaninghacks #cleaningmotivation #cleaningtips #instaclean #cleaningaccount

Guys, I’m an author!!!! I’ve written a book!! 🥹🥹🥹 I can’t believe I’m writing this! 🤯 I am beyond thankful to you all for following along and being so supportive of the content I share 🥰
‘The 5 Minute Clean Routine’ came about as I wanted to help those of you that feel overwhelmed with the continuous housework.  I wanted you all to gain something from this book so it not only includes over 100 cleaning tips and tricks (many of which only take 5 minutes or less) but it will also guide you through building a personal daily, weekly and monthly cleaning routine that fits in with you and your own home. As well as this, it also helps you learn about what can help motivate you based on your personality as getting started is always the hardest part!
You can pre order ‘The 5 Minute Clean Routine’ now using the link in my bio! 🥰⬆️
Thank you again for everything! I am always overwhelmed with your support! 🥹❤️ and a huge thank you @rosieadams98 @outreachtalentgroup and @penguinrandomhouse for believing in me and supporting me through this process 🥰 It’s a dream come true! 💫
.

It doesn’t get much quicker than this 🙌🏼 bringing you another super quick dinner idea that is a go to for us for those low energy nights! 
.
All you need to do is cook the mince with some taco seasoning, add that along with lettuce, Doritos, nacho sauce and a bit of cheese to the wrap, fold it up making sure the lettuce and mince are in the middle layer so that when you toast it on each side some of the mince doesn’t end up falling out and the lettuce doesn’t go soggy (I learnt this the hard way! 🤣) and that’s it! Enjoy!
.

Who else is guilty for number 3? Walking past your dishwasher multiple times a day hoping it will miraculously empty itself? 🙈

I started cleaning and somehow ended up deep cleaning the tops of my kitchen cupboards… a job I’d been putting off for 5 MONTHS because my brain had convinced me it would take forever.

So I timed it: 10 minutes 14 seconds. 😳

Then the toaster I’d been putting off for 3 months: 4 minutes 8 seconds.

And finally, the dishwasher I apparently expect to magically empty itself all day? 2 minutes 35 seconds. 😂

Proof that the jobs we put off rarely take as long as our brains tell us they will!

What are you guilty of ignoring? 👀 

#cleaningtips #cleaningmotivation #cleaningaccount #cleaninghacks #instaclean

I can’t believe we’re in August already! Here are 5 of your favourite home hacks of 2026 so far ✨

1. ☀️ Break down stubborn suncream stains by soaking them in citric acid before washing as normal with a scoop of Napisan or Oxi Action. Use white vinegar in place of fabric softener to help lift any lingering odours and residue.
2. 🏷️ Remove stubborn stickers with a hairdryer. The heat softens the adhesive and makes them much easier to peel away. If there’s any sticky residue left behind, a little nail varnish remover can help dissolve it.
3. ☕️ Whiten caffeine-stained mugs with a denture tablet. Just pop one into the mug with hot water, leave it to work, then rinse thoroughly.
4. 🚿 Denture tablets aren’t just for dentures! They can also help freshen up your drains. Pop one on the drain cover or down the drain if there isn’t a cover, add some hot water and let it fizz away.
5. 🧼 Use your mop for more than just floors! A mop can make cleaning larger surfaces like baths, shower trays, tiles and even windows much quicker. Just remember to use separate mop heads for different areas!

Which one is your favourite? 👇

Who else avoids cleaning their bathrooms? 👀

I was convinced this would take me 45 minutes to an hour… but it literally took 22 minutes and 29 seconds! Plus I probably could’ve shaved off another couple of minutes if I didn’t have to keep moving the camera around too 😂

But this is exactly why I’ve started timing the cleaning jobs I procrastinate because my brain massively exaggerates how long they’ll take, I put them off, and then they become even bigger jobs in my head.

So if there’s a cleaning job you’ve been avoiding, take this as your sign to time it because trust me, it won’t take as long as your brain tells you it will 🧼

Let me know in the comments, what job have you been putting off? 👇🏼

Dumping everything in a dish are my favourite dinners for those low energy days. All I had to do pretty much was boil some pasta! 🙌🏼 
Recipe serves 2-3 people:
✨Place 2 pieces of Salmon, 1 block of feta, 200g cherry or plum tomatoes, 2 handfuls of spinach, 1 tablespoon pesto, seasoning of choice, drizzle of olive oil into a dish.
✨Cook for 30 minutes on 170c (fan assisted oven)
✨Add 200g cooked pasta and a tablespoon of pasta water and mix
✨Serve with grated cheese of choice! 
.

What’s one job you’ve been putting off because your brain keeps telling you it’ll take ages? 👀

After so many of you asked me to do another one, here’s round two of timing the jobs I’ve been avoiding to see how long they actually take ⏱️

I’ve realised my brain is really good at convincing me that certain jobs are going to take forever… so I keep putting them off but this little experiment is definitely helping to retrain my brain!

This week’s results:
✨ Windows: procrastinated for 5 weeks - actually took 12 minutes 53 seconds
✨ Kettle: procrastinated for 3 months - actually took 7 minutes 19 seconds (using my citric acid hack!)
✨ Chairs: procrastinated for 3 weeks - actually took 11 minutes and 21 seconds 

This week I also realised something else… I kept waiting until I felt motivated to start, but the motivation came once I’d got going! 

Now tell me… what’s been sitting on your to-do list for weeks (or even months)? 👇

#procrastinating #cleaningtips #cleaningmotivation #cleaningaccount cleanwithme

My DMs have been busy with requests about this, so here’s 4 DIY fly repellent hacks I’ve found online that are definitely worth trying 🪰✨

1. Fill a saucepan halfway with water, add 1 sliced lemon, 1–2 sprigs of rosemary, 10–20 cloves and 10–20 drops of lemongrass essential oil. Bring to the boil, then simmer. Top up the water as and when needed — refresh every couple of days when the scent starts to fade.
2. Sprinkle cinnamon around the base and inside the lid of your bins to help deter flies from hanging around those unwanted smells 🗑️
3. Add cloves to half a lemon and place it in your fruit bowl to help keep fruit flies away 🍋
4. Place mint near an open window to help discourage flies from coming in 🌿

Which one will you try first? 👇
.
#cleaninghacks #lifehacks #homehacks #cleaningtips #cleaningaccount

Are you guilty of procrastinating too? 👀 What’s one job you’ve been putting off because you think it’ll take ages? 

I realised I spend far longer thinking about certain jobs than actually doing them.

So I timed some of the tasks I’ve been avoiding to see how long it really takes and hopefully retrain my brain in the process!

This week’s results:
✨ Skylight: procrastinated for 5 weeks and time it actually took was 7 minutes 24 seconds.
✨ Sticker removal: procrastinated for 3 months and time it actually took was 5 minutes and 2 seconds.
✨ Clearing stairs: procrastinated for 1 week and time it actually took was 1 minute 42 seconds.

Turns out procrastination is often way more time-consuming than the job itself.

Now tell me… what’s been sitting on your to-do list for weeks (or months)? ⬇️
